q: Our Oragadam plant supplies carmakers near Chennai. What carbon data should we have ready?
title: Oragadam auto supplier carbon data
short: Have a year of electricity bills, diesel and LPG invoices, and production by part, giving Scope 1 and 2 and a figure per part. Grid power at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 is usually the biggest own source; purchased steel and aluminium are larger still.
audience: Automotive suppliers in Oragadam, Sriperumbudur and the Chennai auto corridor

ul: HT electricity bills with units and any solar or open access.
Diesel for generators, LPG for furnaces.

p: Use the CEA grid factor of 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and IPCC fuel defaults, stating both.
Ask steel and aluminium suppliers for their figures; give defaults where you have none, labelled as estimates.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

links.label: Carbon per kg or per piece
